description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nawa Morape, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330312
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
